mapper.select: SELECT id FROM book_inventory WHERE book_id = #{bookId} AND is_deleted = 0 AND status = 'AVAILABLE' ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO book_loans (user_id, book_inventory_id, loan_date, created_by) VALUES (#{userId}, #{inventoryId}, #{loanDate}, #{createdBy})
mapper.select: SELECT bi.id FROM book_loans bl JOIN book_inventory bi ON bi.id = bl.book_inventory_id WHERE bl.id = #{loanId} AND bl.user_id = #{userId} AND bl.return_date IS NULL AND bl.is_deleted = 0 AND bi.is_deleted = 0 LIMIT 1

SELECT bl.id AS loan_id, bi.book_id AS book_id, bi.id AS inventory_id, b.title AS title, b.author AS author, b.cover_url AS cover_url, bl.loan_date AS loan_date, bl.return_date AS return_date FROM book_loans bl JOIN book_inventory bi ON bi.id = bl.book_inventory_id JOIN books b ON b.id = bi.book_id WHERE bl.user_id = #{userId} AND bl.is_deleted = 0 AND bi.is_deleted = 0 AND b.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY CASE WHEN bl.return_date IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END ASC, bl.loan_date DESC LIMIT 20
